metadata.description: Plugins for querying and interacting with the Numerai Tournament platform.

plugins.name: numerai-ql
plugins.description: Skill that teaches Claude to query the Numerai Tournament GraphQL API (model performance, leaderboards, rounds, intra-round daily scores, NMR price, datasets).

plugins.name: numerai-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server exposing common Numerai GraphQL queries as tools (tournaments, rounds, account, leaderboard, model, submissions, datasets, NMR price, round details, raw GraphQL).
